company.name: Zepto
company.description: Zepto is a quick-commerce startup in India that delivers groceries and daily essentials in 10 minutes. Using a network of lightning-fast dark stores, smart inventory management, and hyperlocal delivery partners, Zepto ensures a seamless, fast, and reliable grocery shopping experience.

products.name: 10-Minute Grocery Delivery
products.description: Order groceries, fruits, vegetables, snacks, beverages, and more, delivered to your doorstep in just 10 minutes.

products.name: Zepto Cafe
products.description: Freshly prepared coffee, tea, snacks, and bakery items delivered instantly along with your grocery orders.

products.name: Zepto Essentials
products.description: Daily-use home essentials like toiletries, cleaning supplies, and personal care items delivered instantly.

products.name: Zepto Value Packs
products.description: Special bulk packs and discounted bundles for families and monthly groceries.

faq.question: What is Zepto?
faq.answer: Zepto is India’s fastest-growing quick-commerce platform that delivers groceries and essentials in under 10 minutes using smart dark-store technology.

faq.question: Who can use Zepto?
faq.answer: Anyone living in major Indian cities like Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad, Pune, and others can use Zepto for instant deliveries.

faq.question: Is there a delivery fee?
faq.answer: Delivery fees vary by location and time. Many orders qualify for free delivery during promotional hours.

faq.question: How does Zepto deliver so fast?
faq.answer: Zepto operates micro-warehouses called dark stores placed strategically around cities. These stores have optimized inventory and delivery routes to ensure 10-minute delivery.

faq.question: Do you deliver at night?
faq.answer: Delivery hours vary by city, but most locations support deliveries from 7 AM to midnight.

faq.question: Is everything delivered fresh?
faq.answer: Yes! Zepto ensures high-quality and fresh groceries through strict sourcing, fast storage rotation, and temperature-controlled packaging.

faq.question: Do you accept digital payments?
faq.answer: Yes, Zepto supports UPI, credit/debit cards, net banking, and popular wallets like PhonePe, Paytm, and Google Pay.

faq.question: Can I track my delivery?
faq.answer: Absolutely. Zepto provides real-time tracking from the moment you place an order until the rider arrives.

faq.question: Is Zepto available in my area?
faq.answer: You can check availability by entering your pin code on the Zepto app or website.

faq.question: How do refunds work?
faq.answer: Refunds for cancelled or missing items are processed instantly back to your original payment method.
